item.title: Agora 0.1.0-beta.4
item.description:
What's new

New

Hermes behind Cloudflare Access. A Hermes behind a Cloudflare Tunnel with an Access login used to fail with "answered HTTP 302". Agora now opens Cloudflare's login in your browser, as cloudflared access login does, or on Cloudflare's page inside Agora if you prefer. It keeps the login in the Keychain and asks again when it runs out.

Fixed

  • Pasting an image into the message box did nothing when the clipboard held only the image, such as a screenshot. It now becomes an attachment.

Install

  1. Download Agora-0.1.0-beta.4.dmg below, open it and drag Agora into Applications.
  2. Open Agora and choose where your Hermes runs: on this Mac, or on another machine.

Needs macOS 15 or later and Hermes v0.23 or later. Runs natively on Apple Silicon and Intel.

First launch

This build isn't notarized by Apple yet, so macOS stops it the first time:

  • Open Agora once, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down and click Open Anyway.
  • Or in Terminal: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Agora.app

Check the download: shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.

Full Changelog: v0.1.0-beta.3...v0.1.0-beta.4
